name: Whiteboard Reel
tagline: A raw talking-head recording goes in, a vertical reel comes out where every idea you explain is drawn on a white board above you.
description: For sharing a tool, a method or a lesson to camera. When you explain something, a clean white board drops over the top of the frame and the idea draws itself on it: numbered steps, a tree, a mind map, a fan of cards revealed one by one, a title with a hand-drawn underline. Your results and the people you learned from pop up as cards, a series badge names your show, and the reel ends on a comment keyword. Pauses and earlier takes are cut out, lowercase captions run the whole way, and a light music bed and quiet sound effects are made for you.
bring: Your raw recording of you explaining or sharing something to camera
Optional: screenshots of the real things you mention (thumbnails, profiles, your analytics)
Optional: your series name and the word people should comment to get your link
get: A 30–60 s vertical reel with whiteboard diagrams, pop-up cards, captions, music and sound effects

needs.name: Reel template, starter scene and sound scripts

steps: Cut the pauses and keep the last take of every line
Mark every explanation and pick a diagram for it
Build each diagram so it draws itself as the words are said
Add the badge, proof cards, captions, music and sound effects
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
